entities.name: Query protein RlmN-like
observations: 350 aa protein with predicted molecular mass 39.24 kDa and pI 9.61.
Pfam detects RlmN_N (PF21016.4; residues 4–63) and Radical_SAM (PF04055.28; residues 107–266).
Best reviewed homologs are dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase RlmN proteins with 43.3–44.7% identity, 97.1–99.1% query coverage, and E-values 4.25e-95 to 3.83e-98.
Likely cytoplasmic radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase; exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Methylates adenine C2 of 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37, producing m2A2503 and m2A37.
Binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).
Radical-SAM chemistry generates 5'-deoxyadenosine; the enzyme uses a catalytic methylcysteine intermediate in the methyl-transfer step.

entities.name: RlmN rRNA A2503 methylation
observations: Adenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-ferredoxin + 2 SAM → 2-methyladenosine(2503) in 23S rRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-ferredoxin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Reaction corresponds to Rhea 42916 in the retrieved homolog annotations.

entities.name: RlmN tRNA A37 methylation
observations: Adenosine(37) in tRNA + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-ferredoxin + 2 SAM → 2-methyladenosine(37) in tRNA + 5'-deoxyadenosine + L-methionine + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-ferredoxin + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Reaction corresponds to Rhea 43332 in the retrieved homolog annotations.
